title: Legal Dispute Becomes a Mix-up? OpenAI Fights Back Against Apple: Your Outsourced Lawyer Sent the Email to the Wrong Person

content_html:
The commercial secret lawsuit between Apple and OpenAI took a dramatic turn on August 4th. After Apple filed an initial injunction and accelerated discovery motion with the U.S. Northern District Court of California, OpenAI directly released a response titled "Apple Got It Wrong," accompanied by screenshots of internal emails and iMessage chat records, accusing Apple's injunction request of being based on misleading statements and management oversights.

This dispute began on July 10th this year. Apple sued former senior systems electrical engineer Chang Liu and former product design vice president Tang Tan (now Chief Hardware Officer at OpenAI), alleging that they systematically stole core design drawings, supply chain secrets, and manufacturing processes for hardware such as iPhones and Apple Watches during their transition to OpenAI and its hardware subsidiary io Products. Subsequently, Apple applied to the court for an initial injunction, aiming to prevent OpenAI and the involved former employees from accessing or using any confidential Apple information, and to compel the involved personnel to testify under oath, claiming that without the injunction, it would suffer irreparable significant harm.

OpenAI's rebuttal dismantled two of Apple's core accusations. First, regarding Apple's claim that "they contacted OpenAI but received no response," the truth was that Apple's external lawyers confused the surnames of two Asian employees, sending emails to the wrong recipients; after OpenAI proactively corrected this mistake, Apple's law firm finally admitted they had sent the emails to the wrong people. Second, regarding Apple's accusation that Chang Liu continued to log in to the internal network after leaving to download engineering files, OpenAI's disclosed iMessage conversations showed that after Chang Liu left in January 2026, it was an Apple employee who approached him, asking for help in finding and providing previous project documents.

Even more embarrassing was that the access rights remained on Apple's side. OpenAI stated that Chang Liu could still access some files after leaving because of poor internal system management at Apple—employees left, but iCloud sharing permissions were not promptly cleared, which ironically became an excuse for later accusing former employees of "unauthorized access."

In its response, OpenAI did not hold back: Apple is a great company that focuses on details, but this lawsuit filled with carelessness, aggressiveness, and personal emotions does not match its reputation; the company has neither and does not want any of Apple's commercial secrets. Following its victory against Musk, this confrontation with Apple has become a new focus in Silicon Valley. Fundamentally, it is a struggle for influence in the next generation of native AI hardware ecosystems— as large model inference efficiency and edge-side Agent capabilities break through, the next generation of AI devices is expected to gradually reshape traditional smartphone and app operating system forms. Apple is rushing to lock down its confidentiality defenses to protect its decades-long consumer electronics supply chain barriers, while OpenAI aims to prove the independence and compliance of its hardware business. As of the time of writing, the Northern District Court of California has yet to make a decision on the injunction application, and Apple has not responded publicly.

content_html_zh:
苹果与OpenAI之间的商业秘密诉讼在8月4日出现戏剧性转折。 在苹果向美国加州北地方法院提出初步禁令和加速发现动议后，OpenAI直接发布了题为“苹果搞错了”的回应，并附上内部电子邮件和iMessage聊天记录的截图，指责苹果的禁令请求基于误导性陈述和管理层疏忽。

这场纠纷始于今年7月10日。 苹果起诉前高级系统电气工程师刘畅和前产品设计副总裁唐坦（现为 OpenAI 首席硬件官），指控他们在向 OpenAI 及其硬件子公司 io 产品过渡期间系统性窃取了 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 等硬件的核心设计图纸、供应链机密和制造流程。 随后，苹果向法院申请初步禁令，旨在阻止OpenAI及涉事前员工访问或使用任何苹果机密信息，并迫使涉事人员宣誓作证，声称如果没有禁令，将遭受不可挽回的重大损害。

OpenAI 的反驳驳斥了苹果的两项核心指控。 首先，关于苹果公司声称“他们联系了OpenAI但没有得到回应”，事实是苹果公司的外部律师混淆了两名亚洲员工的姓氏，将电子邮件发送给了错误的收件人；在OpenAI主动纠正这一错误后，苹果律师事务所最终承认他们将电子邮件发送给了错误的人。 其次，关于苹果指控刘畅离职后继续登录内部网络下载工程文件的问题，OpenAI披露的iMessage对话显示，2026年1月刘畅离职后，是一名苹果员工找到他，请求帮助查找并提供之前的项目文件。

更尴尬的是，访问权仍然在苹果这边。 OpenAI表示，由于苹果内部系统管理不善，刘畅离职后仍然可以访问部分文件——员工离职，但iCloud共享权限没有及时清除，讽刺的是，这成为后来指责前员工“未经授权访问”的借口。

OpenAI在回应中也毫不客气：苹果是一家注重细节的伟大公司，但这场充满粗心、攻击性和个人情绪的诉讼与它的声誉不符；该公司既没有也不想要苹果的任何商业秘密。 继战胜马斯克之后，这场与苹果的对抗也成为硅谷新的焦点。 从根本上来说，这是对下一代原生AI硬件生态影响力的争夺——随着大模型推理效率和边缘侧Agent能力的突破，下一代AI设备有望逐步重塑传统智能手机和App操作系统形态。 苹果正急于锁定其保密防御措施，以保护其长达数十年的消费电子供应链壁垒，而OpenAI则旨在证明其硬件业务的独立性和合规性。 截至发稿，加州北区法院尚未就禁令申请做出决定，苹果也未公开回应。
